entity.name: Somdipto Nandy
entity.description: Independent builder and student from Bengaluru, India. I build open computer-use agents and models, including Laya-CUA. I fund my work through grants while studying full time.

projects.name: Laya-CUA
projects.description: An open-source computer-use agent that picks the next computer-use action type, fine-tuned from a 421M decision encoder. Scores 85.9% against a 74.4% baseline on 469 held-out computer-use steps. Includes the training notebook, AgentNet converter, and results log. A young project, maintained in the open.

plans.name: Laya-CUA development
plans.description: Support continued development, evaluation compute, and documentation for Laya-CUA.
